description: This file defines the CrmManager class, which manages CRM interactions such as creating, updating, deleting events, and handling contacts and attendees within a CRM system.

classes.name: CrmManager
classes.description: A class that manages CRM operations such as event creation, updates, deletions, and contact management.

methods.name: getCrmService
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the CRM service instance.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in the CRM, handling contact creation if necessary.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event in the CRM.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event from the CRM.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Fetches contacts from the CRM based on provided parameters.

methods.name: createContacts
methods.description: Creates new contacts in the CRM.

methods.name: handleAttendeeNoShow
methods.description: Handles the no-show status of attendees in the CRM.
